2610.10655.title: Nullify: Null-Space Activation Steering for Training-Free LLM Unlearning
2610.10655.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) inevitably internalize substantial amounts of sensitive or private information during pre-training, while LLM unlearning aims to selectively erase specific knowledge to prevent privacy leakage with minimal loss of model utility. However, existing methods struggle to balance forget quality with utility, and typically incur substantial computational costs due to parameter fine-tuning. To address this, we propose Nullify, a training-free, non-destructive activation steering method for LLM unlearning. Nullify employs steering vectors during inference to redirect privacy-related activations away from their memorized answers, while satisfying a null-space constraint that leaves retained-query activations essentially unaffected to maintain utility. Evaluations on TOFU and MUSE show that Nullify matches or surpasses established baselines in forget quality while achieving near-lossless preservation of model utility. By avoiding weight updates entirely, Nullify serves as an efficient, plug-and-play inference-time intervention framework.
2610.10655.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在預訓練過程中不可避免地內化大量敏感或私密信息，而LLM遺忘旨在有選擇性地抹去特定知識，以防止隱私洩露，同時最小化模型效用的損失。<lb/>然而，現有方法在忘記質量與效用之間難以取得平衡，通常因參數微調而產生相當大的計算成本。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了Nullify，一種無需訓練的非破壞性激活引導方法，用於LLM遺忘。<lb/>Nullify在推理過程中使用引導向量，將與隱私相關的激活重定向，遠離其記憶的答案，同時滿足一個空間約束，使得保留查詢的激活基本不受影響，以維持效用。<lb/>在TOFU和MUSE上的評估顯示，Nullify在忘記質量上與現有基準相匹配或超越，同時實現了幾乎無損的模型效用保留。<lb/>通過完全避免權重更新，Nullify作為一個高效的即插即用推理時干預框架。
